# HASK–HADocs Distribution and Trust Preflight

The pilot uses an explicit local installation path and verifies manifest plus artifact SHA-256 offline. Production options are an embedded release artifact or separately installed local bundle; network download is excluded from the pilot. A future release needs a signed release manifest, defined trust root, atomic installation, retained previous bundle for rollback, stale-content policy, supported-version window and offline fallback. SHA-256 proves integrity against the manifest, not publisher authenticity. No signing is implemented here.
